subject: general
question: Who was the first woman Election Commissioner of Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Neela Satyaanarayan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Neela Satyanarayan** **was the first woman Election Commissioner of Maharashtra.**
 
• She was a former IAS officer who passed away in July 2020.
 
• The 1972 batch IAS officer was admitted to the hospital after she was diagnosed with COVID-19.
 
• She was an **additional Chief Secretary of the Revenue department and post-retirement, in 2009**, she was made the state election commissioner.
 
• **Mrs. Neela retired on July 5, 2014.**
 
• **Maharashtra**:
 
 
• **Number of Districts** - 36.
 
• **Lok Sabha seats** - 48.
 
• **Rajya Sabha seats** - 19.
 
• **State Animal** - Indian giant squirrel.
 
• **State Bird **- Yellow-footed green pigeon.
